Figure 7: Prefill latency (ms) and Decode latency (ms) of each token of Native SVD, Dense(Pytorch), Dense(vLLM) and PARSE on LLaMA-7B, across compression ratios and batch sizes.

Figure 3: Overview of the proposed framework with example of W ∈ R5×5. (a) Rank Expert Decomposition. Each SVD-compressed weight matrix is reformulated as a set of independent rank experts. (b) Router Training. The router is optimized via a straight-through top-K estimator with a reconstruction loss against the dense model output. (c) Static vs. Prompt-Aware Selection. Static truncation retains a static subset for all inputs, while our router selects a prompt-aware subset.
